title: There is no credited way to run a focused Vitest check through the test launcher on Windows: `npx` is not found inside the launcher, and `node …/vitest.mjs` is not recognised as a test, so the run silently records nothing
outcome: A focused launcher run of Vitest on Windows is both runnable and recognised as a test, so a passing or failing focused UI check is host-recorded. Either the launcher resolves npx (or its .cmd shim) without a shell, or the recognizer accepts the launcher-relative `node <ui>/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run` form. A focused command that is not recognised as a test reports that plainly instead of recording nothing in silence.
acceptance: There is no credited way to run a focused Vitest check through the test launcher on Windows: `npx` is not found inside the launcher, and `node …/vitest.mjs` is not recognised as a test, so the run silently records nothing is done
